rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) names the item. Text cells and combs: caption left of or above the cell, or the column header. Amounts: the 12/11-slot peso comb with the 2-slot centavo comb directly right form one money_joins pair. Boxes: X in the box immediately left of the printed option. Radios whose ids carry no printed identity (j_id217/392/393/394/395) are joined by the meaning the model gives each one and the printed option order of their row. Since #113: the model fixes the item meanings (txtTax is the taxable base for item 12 and Schedule 4 item 2, txtRate the item 14 tax due; txtRDOCode14A the property RDO; txtSellerAddress the registered address); seller/buyer TINs, the page 2 header, Item 11 specify, Schedule 1 lot/improvement rows and Schedule 4 A print from derived: keys of Form1706Draft::to_print_field_map. Additional seller/buyer rows, the Part III and tax agent blocks have no layout keys and stay blank; every other value has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason.
